doc: Runtime locale integrity allowlist. Values legitimately NOT localized, matched against application-owned UI text/attributes only. match: 'exact' (default) compares the whole trimmed value; 'regex' searches; contains:true allows a token inside a longer value. Every entry needs a category and a reason. NO broad bypasses (no 'allow all English/Persian', no per-file/per-route blanket rules).
